描述_EN: the mark is written horizontally in four seal characters in red enamel within the foot. the stem is covered with a light green enamel veined with grey, apparently to imitate marble. dish with rounded sides and slightly everted rim, set on a high, spreading, hollow foot ribbed just below the join, painted with sprays of chrysanthemum, lotus, magnolia and other flowers interspersed among four butterflies, in overglaze polychrome enamels in the famille rose palette.
描述_ZN: 底内有红色珐琅彩横写的四个篆字的标记。 茎上覆盖着浅绿色的珐琅，上面有灰色的脉络，显然是为了模仿大理石。 盘子，圆边，边缘微微翘起，置于高而平展的空底上，在接缝处有棱角，用釉上多色珐琅彩绘有菊花、荷花、玉兰和其他花朵，并穿插着四只蝴蝶。
